meta.title: Events list and the Create Event menu: the "DRAFTS196" tab opens

steps.note: Open the Events list from the buyer portal.
Verify the list rendered with the Create Event control and no initial error.
Open the Drafts tab, corresponding to the DRAFTS196 control described in the case.
Verify the Drafts tab shows the expected draft content date.
Verify the named draft entry is visible.
Verify the second named draft entry is visible.
Confirm the Drafts tab content opened without an application error.
